mechanism: Start from a calm material baseline, generate one localized disturbance from that same material, assemble the disturbance into one short readable word, hold it long enough for verification, then let gravity or flow dissolve every letter back into the original surface. The ending must visually match the opening state closely enough to support a clean loop.

invariants.rule: Establish a calm baseline using one clearly identifiable material.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, the return cannot be judged.

invariants.rule: Form every letter from the same disturbed material.
invariants.purpose: Keeps typography inside the physical world.
invariants.ablation_failure: A digital overlay breaks causal coherence.

invariants.rule: Use one short word and hold it long enough to read.
invariants.ablation_failure: Long text or a brief flash becomes illegible.

invariants.rule: Dissolve the word through the same material law that formed it.
invariants.ablation_failure: A fade-out bypasses the material logic.

invariants.rule: Return camera and surface close to the opening state.
invariants.ablation_failure: A changed ending removes the satisfying reset.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
